I work on collaborative projects that connect substantive questions about inequality with longitudinal, quantitative, and relational methods. The portfolio below highlights current and recent work.
:::

## Current research

::: {.record-list}
::: {.record .record-featured}
<p class="record-meta">DPhil research · 2024–present</p>

::: {}
### Networks and gender disparities across academic careers

My doctoral research examines how co-authorship and research-funding networks shape gendered career trajectories among education researchers in Latin America. It brings together research-on-research, organisational context, and longitudinal network modelling.

<p class="record-notes"><strong>Role:</strong> Doctoral researcher<br><strong>Institution:</strong> University of Oxford<br><strong>Supervisors:</strong> Alis Oancea and Lars-Erik Malmberg</p>

<p class="record-topics">Longitudinal networks, gender, higher education</p>
:::
:::

::: {.record}
<p class="record-meta">2025–present</p>

::: {}
### Choosing schools with a click

Studies how parents and guardians appropriate information about Chile’s School Admission System and how digital information shapes school choice.

<p class="record-notes"><strong>Grant:</strong> FONDECYT Regular 1250492<br><strong>Role:</strong> Research Assistant · CIAE, Universidad de Chile</p>
:::
:::

::: {.record}
<p class="record-meta">2023–present</p>

::: {}
### Gender segregation across knowledge areas

Investigates the background, moderators, and consequences of gender segregation in Chilean academic secondary education.

<p class="record-notes"><strong>Grant:</strong> FONDECYT Regular 1231930<br><strong>PI:</strong> Lorena Ortega<br><strong>Role:</strong> Research Assistant · CIAE, Universidad de Chile</p>
:::
:::
:::

## Earlier projects

My earlier work includes gender gaps in mathematics, knowledge production in Latin American universities, teacher-student interaction networks, reader education, and social participation. The complete record is available in my [CV](files/Montero_CV.pdf){target="_blank"}.
